1981-5070-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5070-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

317-413-1475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-413-1475.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
When the Spirit(s) enter, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

628-728-6487.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-728-6487.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Grimgrin ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1562-4375-8095.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4186-6495-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-6495-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
4186-6495-6872.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-969-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-969-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4927-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-804-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-804-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima the Impostor and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-804-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4968-7743.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
4968-7743.description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7727.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

372-2417-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2417-7487.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

661-3685-4659-4908.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1169-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

1621-4590-7042.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
1621-4590-7042.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3330-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

862-4053-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-2511-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

4905-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4905-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

662-1978-3990.description:
Cause Incubation Druid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-4030-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-4030-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

2743-6231-6618.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-6231-6618.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6231-6618.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Relm's Sketching at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Relm's Sketching spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1029-4188-5028.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
1029-4188-5028.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Accomplished Alchemist.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-4188-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2281-2757-5006-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2757-5006-5256.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Lurrus's power.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1202-4647-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers twice.
Resolve both Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Nim Deathmantle trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5075.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ogre Slumlord and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

967-1806-2604-4666-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player for an amount equal to Eternal Scourge's power.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
